Warhammaer 40,000: Space Marine 3 is an upcoming third-person shooter, with hack and slash elements, video game developed by Saber St. Petersburg and published by Focus Entertainment. The sequel to Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine (2011) and Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 (2024), it was released for PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S.
Gameplay
Gameplay
In Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 3, the player engages enemies using a mix of both melee and ranged combat from a third-person point of view.
